info.about: Chaos Field is a 2004 vertically scrolling shooter arcade video game developed by MileStone. The game consists entirely of boss battles, featuring five stages with three bosses each.
info.trivia: It was the first game from MileStone, a studio founded by former Compile staff to make shooters in the style Compile was known for.
info.why: The GameCube disc is the only release of Chaos Field outside Japan, so Western shoot-'em-up collectors have a single edition to find.
